title: Use Rust for application code with narrow language exceptions
abstract: Use Rust for application implementation. Non-Rust website implementation requires an explicit justification. For standalone scripting, use Lua. Prefer TOML, JSON, and Markdown for configuration or documentation where appropriate; these are formats rather than exceptions authorizing another application language.
unresolved: Define 'website code' versus 'scripting' precisely during processing.
Do not retroactively apply a queued specimen to existing code.
